description: A single flat weathered obsidian pavement slab, viewed overhead as a walkable floor tile in a subdued abandoned foundry. Full rectangular opaque canvas 32x24. Eighty five percent one flat ash mauve midtone #5b5966, one shallow dark irregular hairline fracture near a corner, two or three small chipped edge clusters, no noise, no pebbles, no raised rock, no bevel box or black outline. Keep all four edges flat #5b5966 so variants blend. Subtle broad plane and restrained side color. Real native pixel art, large quiet low contrast connected pixel clusters.
